title: Release vote: Apache Iceberg Terraform Provider v0.1.0 RC2
summary: zeroshade (Matt) proposed release candidate 2 of the Apache Iceberg Terraform provider v0.1.0, based on commit 186d4f48b9e98386b044e1367d6fdf8d47a3ff8d, with the source release on dist.apache.org and convenience binaries for the Terraform and OpenTofu registries attached to a GitHub prerelease. rambleraptor voted +1 non-binding after the release script, RAT check, build, tests and checksums succeeded. JB Onofré voted 0 non-binding: the source distribution is correct, but the LICENSE in the binary distribution omits four dependencies that come transitively from iceberg-go v0.6.0 (hashicorp golang-lru, golang.org/x/oauth2, twmb/avro and clipperhouse/uax29) and lists some that are not in the distribution. Matt replied that he is preparing a PR to fix the LICENSE issues. No vote result is stated in the thread.

positions.stance: +1 non-binding; the release script, RAT check, build, tests and checksums all pass.
0 non-binding; the source distribution is correct, but the binary distribution's LICENSE misses some bundled dependencies and lists others that are not included, and should be fixed.
Is preparing a PR to fix the LICENSE issues.

outcome.note: No result is announced. The thread shows one non-binding +1 and one non-binding 0, and the release manager is preparing a fix for the binary LICENSE.

why_it_matters: The first Terraform provider release is held up by licensing details of the binary distribution.
